title: Juicy Marinated Polish Tofu Bowl
description: A fermented and juicy Polish dish featuring marinated tofu, perfect for meal prep, and egg-free friendly.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into bite sized pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together marinade sauce, salt, and black pepper.
Add the tofu to the marinade and mix well to coat, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pot, boil the diced potatoes until they are tender, then drain and set aside.
In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the grated carrots to the pan and cook until they start to soften.
Add the sauerkraut to the pan and cook until heated through.
Remove the tofu from the marinade and add to the pan, cooking until the tofu is lightly browned on all sides.
To assemble the bowls, divide the boiled potatoes, carrot and sauerkraut mixture, and marinated tofu among four bowls.
